column1: # User's own R packages (github.com/sims1253), run as a separate suite group.
# Pinned by commit; their test suites scored against GNU R 4.5.0 like the
# CRAN selection, but this group does not change the CRAN selection's
# numbers. Packages whose dependency tree is impractical in CI are listed
# with reason_excluded and not run. Written and maintained by hand.

column9: Imports brms (a hard dependency) and its tests fit/compare brms models; the brms+Stan dependency tree and fitting are impractical in CI.
NeedsCompilation with Rust/Cargo (SystemRequirements Cargo, rustc) and has no test suite; building a Rust-linked R package in the oracle is not part of the package-suite flow.
SystemRequirements: libhegel loaded at runtime; tests need the native hegel engine, which is not available in the oracle.
Imports FITfileR via a non-CRAN Remotes (grimbough/FITfileR) and FIT-file test fixtures; resolving the remote git dependency and supplying test data is impractical in the pinned suite.
